LightningComponentBundle.description: B2B - Visual carousel of the Contacts linked to an Account. Photo (or initials fallback), title, optional role badge and quick Email/Call actions. Arrows to navigate when there are more than the visible count.

property.name: orderBy
property.label: Sort
property.description: Whitelisted: LastActivityDate DESC NULLS LAST | Name ASC | CreatedDate DESC | Title ASC NULLS LAST.

property.name: visibleCount
property.label: Cards visible at once
property.description: Number of cards shown per page in the carousel. Arrows paginate by this amount.

property.name: badgesCsv
property.label: Role badges (name=label|color, CSV)
property.description: Per-contact badge overlay. Format: 'Eliott Mercier=Champion|#2e844a,Mathieu Bernard=Detractor|#ba0517'. Match is case-insensitive on Contact.Name.
